items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: So they asked a fellow named Fernandez.

ctx.x: I think we had a big role in the band. After you finished the boat job, what did you do then?

Well, I went to Chicago. See, it had to go fair. I went to Chicago out of Davenport. That's where we finished our summer season. And I had to either come by the way of St. Louis or Chicago to come back home. So I went to Chicago. And the first night I got a job with George Fields. And T.O.A. had just ran away from those. They left over that band and they had an opening. So they asked a fellow named Fernandez. Used to play with Dave Peet and they helped play with them. You know, after the show at the Grand Heath…
